purpose: Teach: 血糖/プラズマ/精子/形容詞/同胞/軍国/乳幼児/生誕

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、糖尿病患者の血糖値管理を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you wrote your paper on blood glucose management in diabetic patients, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, steady check-in. Open and curious, leaning slightly forward. The tone of a teacher who already knows the answer but wants to hear the student's own framing. Patient pace.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、プラズマ技術の応用研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I actually wrote mine on applied plasma technology research.
lines.style: Clear, direct response. A beat of slight surprise or correction underneath — this is the opposite topic. Steady eye contact, respectful but not deferring. Natural teen cadence.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 不妊治療の精子検査を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Interesting. And you covered infertility treatment and sperm analysis in your paper, right?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Genuinely intrigued by the mismatch. Soft, reflective tone — not testing, genuinely curious. Slow, measured delivery. Slight lift at the end.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、日本語の形容詞の歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No, actually — mine was on the history of Japanese adjectives.
lines.style: Polite but clear correction. Not defensive, just factual. A slight smile of patience with the pattern. Calm, straightforward delivery. Teen sincerity without edge.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 在外同胞のコミュニティを論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You also touched on diaspora communities and compatriot networks in your research, I imagine?
lines.style: Engaged, collaborative framing. Leaning into the conversation. Warm but also testing — there's playfulness here, a rhythm building. Open curiosity, gentle pace.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、軍国主義時代の教育を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, I focused on education during the militaristic era in Japan.
lines.style: Steady correction again, no irritation. There's almost a smile in the voice now — she's caught onto the pattern too. Clear, composed, natural teen rhythm without resignation.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 乳幼児の発達心理学を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And surely your research covered infant development psychology?
lines.style: Light, knowing warmth now. A gentle tease underneath the formal framing. Slower pace, almost playful. The teacher enjoying the rhythm they've built together.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、ルネサンス期の生誕図像を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No — I wrote about nativity imagery during the Renaissance period.
lines.style: Calm, clear final answer. A note of quiet amusement in her voice. She knows what's happening now. Closes the exchange with composed poise. Warm without trying to be.
